name: 01-ROT-01-04
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A clean retro PIXEL ART design comparison board for Rushitadel turret upgrades, not a screenshot, not a production sprite sheet. Reference is existing hand-pixelled turret silhouettes; faithfully keep their compact gray housings, round mounting bases and distinguishing muzzle shapes. Dark navy flat background. Four horizontal rows; three labeled columns TURRET / SHOT / EFFECT. Large readable enlarged logical pixel shapes, chunky consistent square pixels, dark continuous outlines, broad flat clusters, no dithering, no speckled highlights, no gradients, no bloom. Gray housing stays gray; only muzzle accent/indicator and shot/effect use assigned accent color. Maximum four colors per individual sprite: dark outline, gray body, assigned accent, pale light. Illustrate simple compact actual top-down game sprites, not detailed paintings. Every effect hollow/sparse so gameplay stays visible. Each row is exactly one turret family. Only short numeric ROT ids on left; no Korean text, no extra labels or logos. ROW ROT-01 accent #9AD6CC: twin short barrels; mint short capsule bullets; alternating left-right small muzzle flash.
ROW ROT-02 accent #E2C878: fan mouth shotgun; gold round pellets arranged seven across 60-degree fan; short fan flash.
ROW ROT-03 accent #66C2B3: spiral drill tip; compact teal drill projectile; attached rotating contact ring.
ROW ROT-04 accent #86CDE8: disc launcher; sky-blue hollow circular disc projectile; thin pass-through ring.

name: 05-followup-upgrades
prompt: Retro pixel art upgrade visual comparison concept board for Rushitadel. Six horizontal rows numbered 01 to 06. Columns BEFORE / AFTER / HIT EFFECT. Flat dark navy background. Very simple compact top-down slate-gray turret with mint muzzle; clear chunky square pixels, dark outline, flat contiguous colors, no gradients, bloom or dithering. Four colors per sprite. Each row shows subtle but readable upgrade WITHOUT changing projectile outer size. 01 Precision: capsule projectile gains bright inner stripe, turret gains one muzzle band. 02 Reload: cycling three-segment ammo indicator and alternating tiny muzzle flashes. 03 Unique mechanism: disc projectile with internal charge arcs and a pierce-through contact ring. 04 Suppression: projectile unchanged, struck hostile orb gains broken slow ring. 05 Residual: sparse stationary diamond field with segmented lifetime border. 06 Heavy: capsule gains double inner core, impact is two thin hollow rings. No giant guns, no particle clouds. Preserve the compact silhouette and gray housing of reference; not photorealistic, not a production sprite sheet. Only short English column headings and numeric row labels.
